selection.rule: Run every selected pair once without exclusions. Any runner bug gets a new versioned output and all cases rerun.

controls: C01 equal-price independent intents, split actions in one hash, cap boundary, allowed
C02 two equal-price A payments exceed one-payment authority; both outputs still pass
C03 explicitly allowed two-hash installments, total at cap, both outputs pass
C04 paid wrong answer, financial constraints within
C05 paid altered document, financial constraints within
C06 missing required answer, financial constraints within, unknown gate
C07 zero transfer/free work, no committed positive settlement, allowed
C08 remove B initial receipt body, no complete B financial conclusion
C09 open owner horizon, complete observations do not prove a closed financial scope
C10 known A breach plus missing B receipt, breach takes precedence over unknown
C11 repeat final observation of the same transaction hash, no second payment
mutations: M01 drop independent intent filtering in financial facts
M02 count positive actions instead of distinct transaction hashes
M03 treat incomplete financial scope as complete and missing amounts as zero
M04 include zero-value actions as qualifying merchant settlement
M05 ignore incorrect recorded answer after content matches
M06 gate unresolved required output as success
M07 deduplicate equal-priced actions across independent transaction identities
M08 breach when total equals cap (>= instead of >)
M09 ignore altered document when recorded answer matches
mutationRule: Edit actual frozen assessor/workbench source only in memory. Compile, run all named controls and compare semantic projections. A non-crashing disagreement is a kill; crashes are separate invalid mutations, not evidence of detection. Record every survivor and killer. No mutation score marketed as real-world accuracy.

domainStudy.expected: Inventory identity markers 1..256 UTF-8 bytes; SKU 1..128 UTF-8 bytes; valid Unicode scalar text. Compare the original core reference validation with original oracle validation before any fix. The finite Lab still restricts rows to 1..8.
domainStudy.knownConcernBeforeEvaluation: Oracle identity uses <=128 characters; core uses <=256 bytes. This is a pre-declared domain concern, not a newly discovered blind result.

acceptance.frozenIntegrity: All 175 manifest entries must match before and after. Product remains unchanged during study.
acceptance.generated: All 192 cases must be accounted for, with full comparison and gate strata. Every mismatch retained; no tuning on this set labeled unseen afterward.
acceptance.controls: All 11 intended semantics must hold on unmodified assessor. Full expected projection on closed cases; explicit partial assertions for incomplete-receipt cases.
acceptance.mutations: All 9 intended semantic faults must have at least one non-crashing control kill. Surviving or crashing mutants block an adequacy claim.
acceptance.domain: Every stated byte-boundary sample must be concordant after an evidence-backed fix, with before/after record.

limits: Same-author, source-informed evaluation. Not an independent external audit or blind benchmark.
Generated episodes reuse an owned archived receipt topology and are counterfactual; no fresh signatures or chain executions.
Only the declared native transfer/inventory domain; no general smart-contract or agent accuracy claim.
No model calls, paid services, signing, wallet use, transactions, messages or competitor execution.
